text.en:
Section 2 paragraph 1 of E.O No. 339 dated July 2004, is hereby
amended to read as follows:
The SRA shall operate and adopt the organizational structure
of a government-owned and controlled corporation consistent
with the prevailing jurisprudence, and"

Repealing Clause. All other executive orders, proclamations,
issuances, rules and regulations or parts therefore which are inconsistent with
the provisions of this Executive Order, are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen. (15) days
after its publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
July in the year
Maris Is hang
By authority of the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
